summary: Revision 2: state the precession sense from tau = r x Mg with explicit axis conventions and add an authored worked value.

payload.rationale: The record gave the precession magnitude but never its sense, so an agent could animate the wrong direction and still match the rate. Revision 2 declares right-handed axes with z up and gravity along -z, derives tau = +rMg y_hat and the resulting counter-clockwise-from-above precession for angular momentum pointing away from the pivot, adds a matching invariant and known limit, and adds an authored defaults block (M 0.5 kg, r 0.1 m, I 2.5e-3 kg m^2, omega 100 rad/s, g 9.81) whose worked value omega_p = 1.962 rad/s is arithmetic on the already-cited relation; the numbers are illustrative and tunable, not measurements.

summary: Hand-derived the precession sense from the cited torque-perpendicular-to-L relation under the newly declared axis conventions.

assumptions: Right-handed axes, z up, gravity along -z, pivot at the origin, horizontal axle with the centre of mass at r x_hat.
Spin angular momentum points outward along the axle away from the pivot, L = I omega x_hat with I omega positive.
payload.remaining_uncertainty: Only the direction algebra was hand-derived (x_hat x z_hat = -y_hat, so tau = +rMg y_hat and L turns from +x_hat toward +y_hat). No rendered scene or solver was run, and the cited section was not re-opened for this revision, so the sense is recorded as a derivation from the already-cited perpendicular-torque relation rather than as a quoted statement.
